The 33-year-old has struggled since arriving in Calgary four years ago, averaging just 15.5 goals and 48.5 points after finishing above 90+ points twice while previously in Florida. Calgary is still hopeful to have Huberdeau healthy and ready for the regular season, but the 14-year pro is already behind the eight ball with the latest news.

kyle capobianco.long: Capobianco fell awkwardly in Tuesday's 5-1 loss to the New Jersey Devils, needing assistance to leave the ice. The 29-year-old defenseman was recently thrust in the Stars' lineup to fill in for an injured Esa Lindell, averaging 10:56 time-on-ice through five games. The Stars have recalled Trey Taylor from Texas (AHL) and he will make his NHL debut as Capobianco's replacement.

Thomas Harley saw an increased role and deployment on the top powerplay unit, which should continue on Saturday. That said, Heiskanen will likely be ready for the Stars following game on Thursday against the Winnipeg Jets.

simon edvinsson.long: Edvinsson will draw back into Detroit's lineup after sitting out their last few games before the break. The 22-year-old Swedish defenseman has emerged as an effective top-pair defenseman for the Red Wings. He is averaging 22:35 time-on-ice and has 17 points (6G / 11A) in 48 games this season.

dylan larkin.det: Detroit has suspended Dylan Larkin without pay.
dylan larkin.long: Hours after Larkin and his agent announced the 30-year-old would no longer play for Detroit, the Red Wings have suspended the 12-year veteran without pay. Every day Larkin does not play, he forfeits $41,237.11. He had two goals and six points in 10 games to begin the 2026-27 season.

john gibson.det: Gibson (lower-body) returned to practice on Friday.
john gibson.long: Gibson left Tuesday's game with a lower-body injury and missed Thursday's game. The Red Wings recalled Michal Postava from the Grand Rapids Griffins (AHL) to back up Daniil Tarasov. Gibson should be ready to return soon, but if he misses any more time, expect Tarasov to be between the pipes.

Janmark is entering his 11th NHL season and was expected to play a complementary role in Edmonton's bottom-six after putting up a goal, eight points and 22 PIMs in 43 games last season.

matthew savoie.long: Savoie did not participate in training camp due to an undisclosed injury, and is roughly eight weeks away from returning according to Head Coach Mike Babcock. The 22-year-old is coming off a strong rookie season in 2025-26 where he had 18-goals, 37 points and 25 PIMs in 82 games played.

zach hyman.det: Hyman (upper-body) has been placed on IR.
zach hyman.long: Hyman exited Edmonton's previous game after only 8:25 time-on-ice with an upper-body injury. It is unclear how long he will be sidelined for, but he will miss at least three more games before he is eligible to be activated from Injured Reserve. The 34-year-old Hyman has battled injuries lately, missing 24 games last season, and already missing six of 12 this season.

devon levi.long: Levi's injury is not expected to be long-term, but it is expected to be week-to-week as Edmonton is now down to Tristan Jarry as their starter. It is very unfortunate for Levi, who was enjoying a career resurgence in Edmonton, with his 6-1-0 record and 3.11 GAA.887 SV%>

Fortunately for Barkov, the injuries are unrelated, and he is about midway through his original two-month recovery timeline.

brock faber.det: Faber (skull fracture) returned to practice on Thursday.
brock faber.long: Faber suffered a scary skull fracture in the Wild's final preseason game and has been sidelined since. The 24-year-old defenseman excelled last season as part of Minnesota's top defensive pair alongside superstar Quinn Hughes, scoring 51 points (15G / 36A) in 80 games. Head Coach John Hynes said Faber's absence will extend beyond the weekend, but his return to practice is an encouraging sign that he is nearing a return.

filip gustavsson.det: Gustavsson (hip) will travel with Minnesota on their upcoming road trip.
filip gustavsson.long: Gustavsson underwent offseason hip surgery and has not yet played in the 2026-27 season. The 27-year-old Gustavsson is entering the first year of a five-year contract extension worth $38 million ($6.8 million AAV) and was poised to duel for playing time with counterpart Jesper Wallstedt, who has become Minnesota's de facto starting goalie. That said, Wallstedt has been the busiest goalie in the NHL this season and performed exceptionally, so it is unclear what type of playing time Gustavsson will get when he returns to action.

seamus casey.det: Casey underwent knee surgery and is expected to be out for 8-to-10 weeks.
seamus casey.long: Casey was expected to battle for a spot on the Devils' opening-night roster, but he underwent knee surgery that will delay his 2026-27 season by 8 to 10 weeks. The 22-year-old defenseman, the Devils' 46th-overall pick in the 2022 NHL Entry Draft, spent most of the 2025-26 season in the AHL, where he tallied 19 points (1G / 18A) in 29 games with the Utica Comets.

mathew barzal.det: Barzal (lower-body) returned to practice in a non-contact jersey on Wednesday.
mathew barzal.long: Barzal continues to work his way back from a knee injury that kept him out of training camp. The Islanders have yet to provide any kind of timeline on his return to the lineup, but initial reports did not suggest he would miss the entire first month of the season. That said, his presence at practice, albeit in a non-contact jersey, is an encouraging sign for the Islanders.

alexander romanov.det: Romanov will undergo surgery to repair an ACL tear and miss 6-8 months.
alexander romanov.long: Romanov exited Tuesday's 5-2 loss to the New York Rangers after just 13:20 of ice time. He was absent from practice on Wednesday, and shortly after, the team announced that he would undergo surgery to repair an ACL tear in his right knee and miss six to eight months. The 26-year-old Romanov missed 67 games last season due to a shoulder injury and is likely to miss the remainder of this season as well, for an additional 81 games.

matias maccelli.det: Maccelli (lower body) practiced in a non-contact jersey and is 2-4 weeks away.
matias maccelli.long: Maccelli has been sidelined for over two weeks with a lower-body injury and will likely miss at least two more weeks. The 26-year-old Maccelli had started the 2026-27 season well before his injury, scoring six points (2G / 4A) in eight games, and had been a fixture on the team's top power-play unit.

calum ritchie.det: Ritchie (lower-body) has been placed on IR retroactive to October 17th.
calum ritchie.long: Ritchie has been sidelined for over a week with a lower-body injury. The 21-year-old Ritchie has two points (1G / 1A) in eight games this season. He was originally given a four-to-six-week recovery timeline, so he is likely still a few weeks away from returning.

ryan pulock.det: Pulock (upper body) practiced in a non-contact jersey and is 2-4 weeks away.
ryan pulock.long: Pulock has been sidelined for a week with an upper-body injury and is still at least two weeks away from returning. The 32-year-old Pulock has one assist, 11 hits, and 23 blocks in 13 games this season.

adam sykora.long: During a late-season stint with the Rangers in 2025-26, Sykora made a notable impact, scoring four points (3G / 1A) in 11 games and making his NHL debut. The 22-year-old Slovak was hoping to play a more regular role at the NHL level in 2026-27, but suffered a lower-body injury in a preseason game on Monday, derailing his season for four to five months.

sean durzi.long: Durzi has not played since October 26th and will likely miss at least a couple more games before he returns from an undisclosed injury. The 28-year-old Durzi is averaging 19:52 time-on-ice and has five points (2G / 3A) in 14 games this season. He was placed on IR on Thursday.

The 33-year-old Swedish goalie had a terrific start this season before his injury, posting a dazzling 1.33 GAA and .945 SV% in eight games (7-1-0).

He had surgery one week later and will be out until at least late December. The 23-year-old Swedish forward was getting favourable deployment early in his tenure with the Senators and scored two points (1G / 1A) in four games.

That said, he was back at practice on Friday and will presumably be ready to suit up on Saturday against the Utah Mammoth. The 24-year-old defenseman is averaging 20:14 time on ice, recording three points (2G / 1A), 43 blocks, and 29 hits in 16 games.

ryan graves.det: Graves is expected to be back in the Penguins' lineup on Tuesday.
ryan graves.long: With Pittsburgh expected to sit nearly half their regular roster on Tuesday vs. St. Louis, Ryan Graves will draw back into the lineup for just the 2nd time since March 22nd. The 30-year-old shut down defensemen has appeared in 21 games with Pittsburgh this season, struggling offensively with just one goal and and 20 SOG while constantly finding himself the odd-man out of the lineup.

bryan rust.det: Rust (lower-body) is out and will be evaluated in six weeks.
bryan rust.long: Rust was sidelined at the start of the season with an upper-body injury and will miss more than a month after being placed on Injured Reserve with a lower-body injury. The 34-year-old is coming off consecutive career-best 65-point seasons, but he has battled some injuries, missing at least 10 games in each of the past three seasons.

yanni gourde.long: Last season, Gourde appeared in all 82 games last season, scoring nine goals and 19 assists (28 points) while playing a key role on the Lightning's checking line with Zemgus Girgensons and Pontus Holmberg. That said, he underwent offseason hip surgery and has been sidelined to start the 2026-27 season. He was originally expected to make his debut in December, but could be slightly ahead of schedule.

john tavares.det: Tavares (lower-body) has a good chance to return vs. Montreal on Saturday.
john tavares.long: Tavares has been sidelined for over two weeks with a lower-body injury. He has practiced the past few days and will likely return on Saturday against the Montreal Canadiens. The 36-year-old Tavares has seven points (2G / 5A) in seven games this season.

elvis merzlikins.long: Merzlikins was acquired from the Blue Jackets as a part of the Kirill Marchenko trade, and is reportedly not a part of the Maple Leafs' goaltending plans. They won't have to make a decision on him for roughly three months, as GM John Chayka said he'll need at least that much time as he continues to rehab from offseason shoulder surgery.

max domi.det: Domi (lower-body) has been added to LTIR.
max domi.long: Domi failed his preseason physical after offseason lower-body surgery and was placed on LTIR on Wednesday, saving the Maple Leafs $3.75 million in cap space. Domi appeared in 80 games for Toronto in 2025-26, picking up 12 goals, 36 points and 95 PIMs. He is without a timeline to return.

kirill marchenko.det: Marchenko (lower-body) has been placed on IR and is still considered week-to-week.
kirill marchenko.long: Toronto lost another top-six forward on Monday after Kirill Marchenko left their game vs. Calgary with a lower-body injury. Marchenko's first 14 games in Toronto have gone very well, with the 26-year-old winger averaging a point per game with six goals and eight assists. Gavin McKenna has been moved up to Toronto's top line in Marchenko's absence.

marshall rifai.det: Rifai is week-to-week with a lower-body injury.
marshall rifai.long: Rifai missed Toronto's game on Thursday vs. New York after leaving morning skate early with a lower-body injury and is now considered week-to-week. The injury couldn't come at a worse time, after Rifai scored his first career NHL goal earlier in the week on Tuesday. Nick Blankenburg replaced him on Thursday in Toronto's lineup.

thatcher demko.long: Demko's 2025-26 season ended in January after a hip injury that required surgery, but he is hopeful to make his 2026-27 debut in December. Demko, who has battled a myriad of injuries in recent seasons, had a 2.90 GAA and .895 SV% in 20 appearances last season (8-10-1). The Canucks begin the 2026-27 season with Kevin Lankinen and Leevi Merilainen as their goaltending tandem.

rasmus sandin.long: Sandin missed the final two games of the 2025-26 regular season, which will extend into the start of the 2026-27 season as he recovers from surgery to address an ACL tear. The 26-year-old Swedish defenseman has become an integral part of Washington's defence core, playing exclusively on one of the top two pairs. He averaged 19:12 time-on-ice and scored 29 points (5G / 24A) in 73 games this season.

vincent desharnais.det: Desharnais underwent a successful appendectomy surgery and is expected to miss the next 4-6 weeks.
vincent desharnais.long: Desharnais played the first nine games of the season for the Kings, but will miss the next several weeks after undergoing an appendectomy. The 30-year-old defenseman is averaging 19:25 time-on-ice and has three assists this season.

nick bjugstad.det: The Devils have acquired Nick Bjugstad, Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command, a 2029 2nd-round pick, and a 2027 7th-round pick from the Devils for Connor Hellebuyck.
nick bjugstad.long: Bjugstad has yet to play this season and is expected to miss at least three more months after recovering from offseason surgery to repair a torn left pectoral muscle. The 34-year-old Bjugstad, a veteran of 821 career games, will provide solid bottom-six depth for the Jets. Last season, he scored nine points (6G / 3A) in 61 combined games with the St. Louis Blues and New Jersey Devils.

vladislav namestnikov.long: Namestnikov played a season-high 13:28 in Winnipeg's 5-2 win over Minnesota on Tuesday, but he did not play on Thursday and will remain out week-to-week. The 33-year-old Russian forward has one assist and is averaging 12:06 time-on-ice through six games this season.

josh morrissey.det: Morrissey (upper-body) is hopeful to return by the weekend.
josh morrissey.long: Morrissey has not played since suffering an upper-body injury nearly four weeks ago. He is accompanying the Jets on their four-game road trip, but he is not expected to be a lineup-option until the weekend. The 31-year-old Morrissey has become a reliable point-producing defenseman and power-play quarterback in recent seasons, a role he should be able to return to when he is ready to suit up.
